name: Husqvarna 550 XP Mark II
blurb: 13″, 16″, 18″ and 20″ bar setups on .325″ chain, .050″ / .058″ gauge, 56–80 drive links — straight from Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide.
intro: The Husqvarna 550 XP Mark II is a rear-handle gas saw. Husqvarna's own 2026 Bar & Chain Fit-up Guide (effective 1 January 2026) lists 4 approved bar lengths for it (13″, 16″, 18″ and 20″), running .325″ pitch chain in .050″ / .058″ gauge.

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 13″ setup with bar X-Force 596199756 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643656.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bars X-Force 596199766 / X-Tough 596689766 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643666 / C33 X-Cut 585642266.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 16″ setup with bars X-Force 596199866 / X-Tough 596689866 and chain S35G X-Cut 585639666 / C35 X-Cut 581699866.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bars X-Force 596199772 / X-Tough 596689772 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643672 / C33 X-Cut 585642272.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 18″ setup with bars X-Force 596199872 / X-Tough 596689872 and chain S35G X-Cut 585639672 / C35 X-Cut 581699872.
Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Force 596199780 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643680 / C33 X-Cut 585642280.
bars.label: 20″ (X-Force bar)

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bar X-Tough 596689778 and chain SP33G X-Cut 581643678 / C33 X-Cut 585642278.
bars.label: 20″ (X-Tough bar)

bars.note: Husqvarna's 2026 fit-up guide pairs this 20″ setup with bars Laminate 596009678 / X-Tough 596689878 and chain S35G X-Cut 585639678 / C35 X-Cut 581699878.
